_readme: Machine-readable freeze manifest for Phase 30 (Additive Foundation & Regression Harness). Consumed by the CI frozen-file guard built in plan 30-05. Two independent freeze classes below: 'files' (NAME-freeze, sha256 of full byte contents — a legitimate change requires bumping the hash here AND adding a reasoned entry to frozen-files-allowlist.json) and 'room_status_values' (VALUE-freeze — see its own '_note', NO allowlist escape, a mismatch is always a hard CI failure). globals.css and tailwind.config.ts are NOT file-hash-frozen (they are additively extended every phase); only the specific room-status token VALUES inside them are frozen and re-parsed live by the guard.

room_status_values._note: HARD CONSTRAINT — no allowlist escape. These encode room cleanliness state (dirty/clean/inspected/occupied/in_progress/pickup/ooo), staff are trained on these exact colors, and per 30-CONTEXT.md they must never change, in :root or .theme-dark, anywhere they render. A mismatch here is always a hard CI failure — it is never resolved via frozen-files-allowlist.json. Note the double-duty warning: --alert/--info/--caution/--ready/--progress/--blocked also serve as generic chrome tokens elsewhere; a new generic semantic color must use a NEW token name (e.g. --danger-v2), never retint one of these.

tailwind_hardcoded_hex._note: apps/web/tailwind.config.ts colors.status.* — static hex duplicates of the same trained room-status meanings, won't move with a token refresh but still frozen at value. colors.risk.* is explicitly NOT room-status and is un-frozen.
